description: This file defines a class 'ChromiumCommit' that interacts with a Git repository to retrieve commit information, such as subject, body, author, and changed files, specifically for Chromium commits related to WebKit testing.

classes.name: ChromiumCommit
classes.description: A class representing a Chromium Git commit, providing methods to retrieve commit details and changed files.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a ChromiumCommit object with host, sha, or position, resolving sha if only position is provided.

methods.name: num_behind_master
methods.description: Returns the number of commits this commit is behind origin/master.

methods.name: position_to_sha
methods.description: Converts a commit position string to a SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Retrieves the commit author's name and email.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Retrieves the full commit message including subject and body.

methods.name: filtered_changed_files
methods.description: Returns a list of changed files in the commit, filtered to exclude certain files.

methods.name: is_baseline
methods.description: Checks if a filename is a baseline expected file.

methods.name: format_patch
methods.description: Creates a patch of the commit's changes, formatted for export.
